contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_indexed_notes_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `indexed_notes` BEGIN DELETE FROM `indexed_notes_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_indexed_notes_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `indexed_notes` BEGIN DELETE FROM `indexed_notes_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_indexed_notes_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `indexed_notes` BEGIN INSERT INTO `indexed_notes_fts`(`docid`, `relativePath`, `title`, `body`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`relativePath`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`body`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_indexed_notes_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `indexed_notes` BEGIN INSERT INTO `indexed_notes_fts`(`docid`, `relativePath`, `title`, `body`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`relativePath`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`body`); END
